description: Plausibility floor for LLM-call token telemetry, consumed by analysis/cost_efficiency/raw_cost.py (fail-fast). A provider that does not report usage the way the API-based providers do can still emit an interaction log carrying a token count that is present but far too small to be a real prompt. Priced, that produces a number which is arithmetically correct and factually wrong -- and worse than an absent one, because nothing downstream can tell it is wrong. This floor turns that case back into 'absent', which is what it is. Measured on swedish_02 2026-08-21: every openrouter_* and ollama_* model reported 304-582 input tokens per call, while the two claude_* models (provider 'claude', the CLI, which does not account usage like the APIs) reported 2.0 and 10.0. The floor sits between those populations with an order of magnitude of headroom on each side; it is not tuned to a single model.
rationale_field: A combination whose mean input tokens per call falls below this is recorded with has_token_data=false and total_cost_usd=null, and carries the reason on the record so the exclusion travels as data rather than as a silent gap.
